dialogues.jp: 「……しんどかった……………」
dialogues.en: "...Finally over......"
dialogues.text: "...Finally over......"

dialogues.jp:
体育の授業を終え、制服に着替えると俺は机の
上に突っ伏した。
dialogues.en:
With gym class done with, I changed back to my school
uniform and fell into my chair.
dialogues.text:
With gym class done with, I changed back to my school
uniform and fell into my chair.

dialogues.jp: このところの体育の授業は連日マラソン。
dialogues.en: We had to run a marathon for gym class today.
dialogues.text: We had to run a marathon for gym class today.

dialogues.jp:
少々季節外れのプログラムは体育講師の手抜き
としか思えない。
dialogues.en:
The instructor forgot to note that it was completely the
wrong season and program for it, though.
dialogues.text:
The instructor forgot to note that it was completely the
wrong season and program for it, though.

dialogues.jp:
だが、それを指摘しようものならもっと過酷な
授業が待っているだろうから、誰もが黙秘を決
め込んでいる。
dialogues.en:
But instead of pointing out the cruel and unusual treatment,
everyone decided to keep silent.
dialogues.text:
But instead of pointing out the cruel and unusual treatment,
everyone decided to keep silent.

dialogues.jp: これ正に沈黙は金なり。
dialogues.en: The moral of the story: silence is not neccessarily golden.
dialogues.text: The moral of the story: silence is not neccessarily golden.

dialogues.speaker: Girl A
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、疲れたねー」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh~, so tired-."
dialogues.text: "Ahhh~, so tired-."

dialogues.speaker: Girl B
dialogues.jp: 「早くマラソンの授業終わればいいのに」
dialogues.en: "That marathon should've been over earlier."
dialogues.text: "That marathon should've been over earlier."

dialogues.jp: そんなことをぼやく女子たちの声が耳に入る。
dialogues.en: "(Those girls take a different course though.)"
dialogues.text: "(Those girls take a different course though.)"

dialogues.jp: （まぁでも、女子は別コースだしなぁ）
dialogues.en:
Although they're both considered marathons, the girl's
course is only 2 kilometres, compared to the guy's course
which is 5.
dialogues.text:
Although they're both considered marathons, the girl's
course is only 2 kilometres, compared to the guy's course
which is 5.

dialogues.jp:
同じマラソンといっても、女子のコースは俺達
男子より２キロも少ない３キロだ。
dialogues.en: If girls really want equal rights so much...
dialogues.text: If girls really want equal rights so much...

dialogues.jp: こんなときこそ男女平等を切実に訴えるね。

dialogues.en: It then hit me.
dialogues.text: It then hit me.

dialogues.jp: そこで俺はふと気付いた。

dialogues.en:
The girl who masquerades as a guy at school, she'd of course
do the 5 kilometre course as well.
dialogues.text:
The girl who masquerades as a guy at school, she'd of course
do the 5 kilometre course as well.

dialogues.jp:
男として学園に通う彼女は、当然男と同じ５キ
ロのコースを走っている。
dialogues.en:
If I, a guy (albeit one who normally doesn't get enough
exercise anyway), gets this exhausted from it...
dialogues.text:
If I, a guy (albeit one who normally doesn't get enough
exercise anyway), gets this exhausted from it...

dialogues.jp:
俺ですら（日頃から運動不足のせいもあるのだ
が）こんなにしんどいのだ………。
dialogues.en:
The way she conceals her womanly figure can't have held up
well under that duress either...
dialogues.text:
The way she conceals her womanly figure can't have held up
well under that duress either...

dialogues.jp: そっと視線をあげて叶の姿を探す。
dialogues.en: I secretly took a little glance at Kanae's figure.
dialogues.text: I secretly took a little glance at Kanae's figure.

dialogues.jp:
席に着いた叶は、視線をおとしたまま微動だに
しない。
dialogues.en:
She was seated at her desk, her eyes downcast, not moving
one bit.
dialogues.text:
She was seated at her desk, her eyes downcast, not moving
one bit.

dialogues.jp:
……クラスでは言葉を交さない。俺達はそう約
束した。
dialogues.en: ...We're not supposed to talk in class. We promised that.
dialogues.text: ...We're not supposed to talk in class. We promised that.

dialogues.jp: だけど……。
dialogues.en: But this...
dialogues.text: But this...

dialogues.jp: 「か……工藤、大丈夫なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ka... Kanae, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Ka... Kanae, are you okay?"

dialogues.jp: ふと不安に襲われ、つい声をかけていた。
dialogues.en: I finally decided to address her, my uneasiness winning out.
dialogues.text: I finally decided to address her, my uneasiness winning out.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Asakura......"
dialogues.text: "Asakura......"

dialogues.jp:
顔をあげた叶は弱々しく微笑んで首を振ってみ
せた。
dialogues.en:
Kanae lifted her face to look at me, and gave me a weak
smile.
dialogues.text:
Kanae lifted her face to look at me, and gave me a weak
smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だいじょうぶ………だから………」

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「………お前、凄い顔色悪いぞ、保健室行こう」
dialogues.en:
".....Your face looks really pale. We're going to the
infirmary."
dialogues.text:
".....Your face looks really pale. We're going to the
infirmary."

dialogues.jp: 叶の腕をとる。
dialogues.en: I took her arm.
dialogues.text: I took her arm.

dialogues.jp: 細い。｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な腕。
dialogues.en: So thin...
dialogues.text: So thin...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに甘えるわけ………に………」
dialogues.en: "I don't need special treat...ment..."
dialogues.text: "I don't need special treat...ment..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Kanae--!!"
dialogues.text: "Kanae--!!"

dialogues.jp: ぐら、と叶の身体が大きくかしいだ。
dialogues.en: Her body fell forward suddenly.
dialogues.text: Her body fell forward suddenly.

dialogues.jp: その身体をすんでの所でがっしりと抱きとめる。
dialogues.en: It was all I could to to keep her from hitting the ground.
dialogues.text: It was all I could to to keep her from hitting the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「きゃあっ………工藤君！？」
dialogues.en: "Kyah!... Kudou-kun!?"
dialogues.text: "Kyah!... Kudou-kun!?"

dialogues.jp: 驚いた女子達の悲鳴が降り注いだ。
dialogues.en: The girls of the class also started to shriek at the sight.
dialogues.text: The girls of the class also started to shriek at the sight.

dialogues.speaker: Teacher
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、授業始めるぞ、席につけ！」
dialogues.en: "Class is about to start, get back to your seats!"
dialogues.text: "Class is about to start, get back to your seats!"

dialogues.jp:
そうこうするうち、次の授業の担当講師が入っ
てきた。俺はかまわず叶の身体を抱き上げてド
アに向かう。
dialogues.en:
Just at that moment, the teacher in charge of the next
lesson entered the classroom. I was still holding on to
Kanae's fallen body.
dialogues.text:
Just at that moment, the teacher in charge of the next
lesson entered the classroom. I was still holding on to
Kanae's fallen body.

dialogues.speaker: Teacher
dialogues.jp: 「おい朝倉、何やってる」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Asakura, what are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Asakura, what are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Teacher
dialogues.jp: 「コイツの具合が悪そうなんで……」
dialogues.en: "He doesn't seem to be feeling well..."
dialogues.text: "He doesn't seem to be feeling well..."

dialogues.speaker: Teacher
dialogues.jp:
「ああ工藤か、おい保健委員いるか？　保健室
　に連れて行ってやれ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, Kudou. Are there any hygeine club members around? Take
him to the infirmary."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, Kudou. Are there any hygeine club members around? Take
him to the infirmary."

dialogues.jp: またお前か、と言うような口ぶりだった。
dialogues.en: "You again". He didn't say it, but he obviously meant it.
dialogues.text: "You again". He didn't say it, but he obviously meant it.

dialogues.jp:
男の癖に情けない奴だというような蔑みの色が
言葉の中からじわじわと染み広がった。
dialogues.en:
People view guys as being more prone to faking sick, and
have less sympathy overall for them, so...
dialogues.text:
People view guys as being more prone to faking sick, and
have less sympathy overall for them, so...

dialogues.speaker: Teacher
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、後は保健委員にまかせて、席につけ」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura, leave this to the hygeine club members, and go
back to your seat."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura, leave this to the hygeine club members, and go
back to your seat."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君………私なら大丈夫だから………」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... I'd be fine, so......"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... I'd be fine, so......"

dialogues.jp: かすれた声で叶がつぶやく。
dialogues.en: Her weak voice rang through my ears.
dialogues.text: Her weak voice rang through my ears.

dialogues.jp: ……俺は静かに首を振った。
dialogues.en: ...I silently shook my head.
dialogues.text: ...I silently shook my head.

dialogues.jp: 「全然大丈夫じゃないだろ、ばか」
dialogues.en: "...You're not fine at all, idiot."
dialogues.text: "...You're not fine at all, idiot."

dialogues.speaker: 講師
dialogues.en: "......Be quiet! Can't you see someone's sick here!?"
dialogues.text: "......Be quiet! Can't you see someone's sick here!?"

dialogues.speaker: 講師
dialogues.jp: 「…………るっせぇ！！　外野は黙ってろ！」
dialogues.en:
The forcefulness of my reply send the whole class into a
stunned silence. Even the teacher was taken aback.
dialogues.text:
The forcefulness of my reply send the whole class into a
stunned silence. Even the teacher was taken aback.

dialogues.jp:
迫力に気圧されたのか、シン、と教室中が静ま
り返った。虚をつかれた講師もそのまま黙りこ
む。
dialogues.en: My head's reeling.
dialogues.text: My head's reeling.

dialogues.jp: 本当頭にくる。
dialogues.en:
In the state I'm in now, I don't know what else I might be
capable of...
dialogues.text:
In the state I'm in now, I don't know what else I might be
capable of...

dialogues.jp:
こいつが普段からどんなに大変な思いをしてい
るか知らないくせに。
dialogues.en: "...I'd accompany him."
dialogues.text: "...I'd accompany him."

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤を抱え足早に静まり返った教室を後に
した。
dialogues.en:
I carried Kudou in my arms, and left the quietened
classroom.
dialogues.text:
I carried Kudou in my arms, and left the quietened
classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫、病気とかじゃないみたいだから」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, it doesn't appear to be an illness."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, it doesn't appear to be an illness."

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「………そう、ですか」

ほっとした瞬間、足から力が抜けた。そのまま
床にへたりこむ。
dialogues.en:
Upon hearing that, my legs gave way, and my butt fell onto a
nearby bed.
dialogues.text:
Upon hearing that, my legs gave way, and my butt fell onto a
nearby bed.

dialogues.jp: ……よかった。
dialogues.en: ...What a relief.
dialogues.text: ...What a relief.

dialogues.jp: 本当に。
dialogues.en: Thank goodness.
dialogues.text: Thank goodness.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君！？　大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun!? Are you alright?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun!? Are you alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ちょっと安心しただけで」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, just relieved..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, just relieved..."

dialogues.jp: 問題ないです。悪いのは頭くらいで……。
dialogues.en: There was nothing wrong. It was just all in my head...
dialogues.text: There was nothing wrong. It was just all in my head...

dialogues.jp:
汗を吸ったシャツが体に張り付き、冷たさを感
じる。
dialogues.en:
I was sweating so much, it soaked my shirt and felt cold to
the touch.
dialogues.text:
I was sweating so much, it soaked my shirt and felt cold to
the touch.

dialogues.jp: 血が上っていた頭もようやく｛さ／醒｝めてきた。
dialogues.en:
The blood returned to my head, bringing my back to my
senses.
dialogues.text:
The blood returned to my head, bringing my back to my
senses.

dialogues.jp: これは戻ったらお小言必至だな。
dialogues.en: Which then allowed me to reflect on the events before.
dialogues.text: Which then allowed me to reflect on the events before.

dialogues.jp: 「ははは……」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha..."

dialogues.jp: 自分の行動が、我ながら可笑しかった。
dialogues.en: I could only sit back and laugh at how I reacted...
dialogues.text: I could only sit back and laugh at how I reacted...

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp:
「ただ、だいぶ疲労が溜まってるみたいね……
　少し休んで落ち着いたら、今日はもう帰りな
　さい」
dialogues.en:
"You seem to be very tired though... once you've rested here
a bit, go home and recharge your batteries for today."
dialogues.text:
"You seem to be very tired though... once you've rested here
a bit, go home and recharge your batteries for today."

dialogues.jp: 体温計を示してゆっくりと告げるゆき先生。
dialogues.en:
Yuki-sensei delivered her advice professionally, as she
checked the thermometer.
dialogues.text:
Yuki-sensei delivered her advice professionally, as she
checked the thermometer.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Okay..."
dialogues.text: "Okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp:
「先生おうちに連絡を入れてくるわ、ごゆっく
　り」
dialogues.en: "I have other things to do now, so I'd leave you two alone."
dialogues.text: "I have other things to do now, so I'd leave you two alone."

dialogues.jp: その言葉に俺と叶は二人揃って頬を赤くする。
dialogues.en: Both Kanae and I turned red.
dialogues.text: Both Kanae and I turned red.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達を見て、いたずらっ子のような微笑
を浮かべ、ゆき先生は保健室を出て行った。
dialogues.en:
Yuki-sensei looked at us with a mischevious smile, before
leaving the infirmary.
dialogues.text:
Yuki-sensei looked at us with a mischevious smile, before
leaving the infirmary.

dialogues.jp: まったくあの先生は……。
dialogues.en: Sheesh, that doctor...
dialogues.text: Sheesh, that doctor...

dialogues.jp:
「コホン……あー、なんだ……ひとりで帰れる
　のか？　なんなら送ってくけど」
dialogues.en:
"Ahem... ah, hmm... going home by yourself? You need an
escort, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahem... ah, hmm... going home by yourself? You need an
escort, right?"

dialogues.jp:
さまざまな思考を振り払うように、咳払いをし
てから言葉をかける。
dialogues.en:
Clearing my head of unsightly thoughts, I broke the
uncomfortable silence.
dialogues.text:
Clearing my head of unsightly thoughts, I broke the
uncomfortable silence.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そんなこと言って、授業サボる気でしょう？
　駄目だよ」
dialogues.en:
"You're trying to skip on your lessons, aren't you? Don't be
like that."
dialogues.text:
"You're trying to skip on your lessons, aren't you? Don't be
like that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ははは、そんなことはないぞぅ」
dialogues.en: "...Hahaha, not at all!"
dialogues.text: "...Hahaha, not at all!"

dialogues.jp: ロボットみたいにカクカクと答えた。
dialogues.en: My reply was as mechanical as could be.
dialogues.text: My reply was as mechanical as could be.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「もう、しょうがないんだから」
dialogues.en: "Geez, you're hopeless!"
dialogues.text: "Geez, you're hopeless!"

dialogues.jp: くすりと笑ってみせる叶の手を軽く握った。
dialogues.en:
She waved her hand dismissively at me, laughing all the
same.
dialogues.text:
She waved her hand dismissively at me, laughing all the
same.

dialogues.jp:
……本当は抱きしめてやりたかった、抱きしめ、
キスして、もういいよ、無理するな、普通の女
の子に戻れよって言ってやりたかった。
dialogues.en:
...I wanted to hold her. Hug her, kiss her, tell her that
it's fine, not to do things she can't, to just be a normal
girl.
dialogues.text:
...I wanted to hold her. Hug her, kiss her, tell her that
it's fine, not to do things she can't, to just be a normal
girl.

dialogues.jp: でも……できなかった。
dialogues.en: But.... I can't. She can't.
dialogues.text: But.... I can't. She can't.

dialogues.jp: 哀しいほどに無力だった。
dialogues.en: It's sad, but I can't do anything.
dialogues.text: It's sad, but I can't do anything.

dialogues.jp: そんな力や資格、俺にはないのだ。
dialogues.en: I don't have the power to change anything at all.
dialogues.text: I don't have the power to change anything at all.

dialogues.jp: 名残惜しかったけど、立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: Filled with regret and reluctance, I stood up.
dialogues.text: Filled with regret and reluctance, I stood up.

dialogues.jp:
「……じゃ、俺は教室に戻ります。ちゃんと休
　めよ」
dialogues.en: "...Then, I'd head back to class. Rest up."
dialogues.text: "...Then, I'd head back to class. Rest up."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「うん…………あの、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... um, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Mm...... um, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.jp: 出て行こうとする俺の背中に叶が声をかける。
dialogues.en: Kanae called out to my back as I was walking out.
dialogues.text: Kanae called out to my back as I was walking out.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい…………それと、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry..... and thank you."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry..... and thank you."

dialogues.jp: 俺はふっと笑って首を振ってみせた。
dialogues.en: Smiling to a glass window, I shook my head.
dialogues.text: Smiling to a glass window, I shook my head.

dialogues.jp: 「『ごめん』は余計だよ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry is too much."
dialogues.text: "Sorry is too much."

dialogues.jp:
授業が終わる早々、俺は職員室に呼び出され、
予想通りこってり油を搾られた。
dialogues.en:
Once classes were over, I was ordered to the staff room, as
expected.
dialogues.text:
Once classes were over, I was ordered to the staff room, as
expected.

dialogues.jp:
小言を右耳から左耳にスルーパスさせながら、
俺はただ、叶が無事に帰れたかどうかだけを考
えていた。
dialogues.en:
All the scoldings went in one ear and out the other though,
as all I could think about was whether Kanae had gotten home
safely.
dialogues.text:
All the scoldings went in one ear and out the other though,
as all I could think about was whether Kanae had gotten home
safely.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が途中で俺を呼び出してくれなかったら、
あのまま夜中まで小言を言われつづけていたん
じゃなかろうか……。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei passed by and told me to see her after as
well. Looks like this is going to take all night.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei passed by and told me to see her after as
well. Looks like this is going to take all night.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お疲れさん」
dialogues.en: "Here you go."
dialogues.text: "Here you go."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どうも……」
dialogues.en: "Thanks..."
dialogues.text: "Thanks..."

dialogues.jp:
ねぎらいのつもりか暦先生がコーヒーを差し出
す。
dialogues.en:
The gratitude was for Koyomi-sensei presenting me with a cup
of coffee.
dialogues.text:
The gratitude was for Koyomi-sensei presenting me with a cup
of coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「お前も考え無しだな、こうなることは分かっ
　てたろうに」
dialogues.en:
"You really don't think much, do you? You knew this was
going to happen."
dialogues.text:
"You really don't think much, do you? You knew this was
going to happen."

dialogues.jp:
そういうのを自業自得というんだと、半ば呆れ
た口調の先生。
dialogues.en:
In other words, I'm suffering the consequences of my own
actions.
dialogues.text:
In other words, I'm suffering the consequences of my own
actions.

dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
ずず、とコーヒーを一口すすって答える。ブラッ
クコーヒーの苦味が舌を刺した。
dialogues.en:
I sipped my coffee and answered at the same time. The bitter
taste burned itself into my tongue.
dialogues.text:
I sipped my coffee and answered at the same time. The bitter
taste burned itself into my tongue.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「でもまぁ、よくやったな。従順な学生ではな
　いもしれんが、男としては合格だ」
dialogues.en:
"I guess it wasn't bad either though. You may fail as a
student, but you certainly pass with flying colours as a
man."
dialogues.text:
"I guess it wasn't bad either though. You may fail as a
student, but you certainly pass with flying colours as a
man."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうっスか……どーも」
dialogues.en: "Is that so... thanks."
dialogues.text: "Is that so... thanks."

dialogues.jp:
なんと返していいものか、照れ半分に言葉を濁
す俺。暦先生は淡々とした調子で続けた。
dialogues.en:
Not knowing how to reply, I half-embarassedly muttered a
response. She continued on with her light chatter.
dialogues.text:
Not knowing how to reply, I half-embarassedly muttered a
response. She continued on with her light chatter.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「好きな娘のために鬼教師に歯向かうとは｛きょうき／侠気｝
　のある行動だよ。なかなか真似は出来ん」
dialogues.en:
"Protecting the girl you love from the demon teacher by
striking back... doesn't sound like something I could do."
dialogues.text:
"Protecting the girl you love from the demon teacher by
striking back... doesn't sound like something I could do."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Fwoohh!!!!!"
dialogues.text: "Fwoohh!!!!!"

dialogues.jp: 口にしていたコーヒーをおもわず吹き出す俺。
dialogues.en: The coffee I was drinking flew out of my mouth."
dialogues.text: The coffee I was drinking flew out of my mouth."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、どうかしたか」
dialogues.en: "Huh, what's up with you?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, what's up with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ぐはげほっ………せ、先生、叶…工藤のこと、
　ご存知だったんですか」
dialogues.en:
"Cough, cough..... s, sensei... Kanae... Kudou, you know
about... it?"
dialogues.text:
"Cough, cough..... s, sensei... Kanae... Kudou, you know
about... it?"

dialogues.jp:
吸い込んだコーヒーがちきちきと器官に染み、
涙目になりつつ俺は答えた。
dialogues.en:
Tears came out of my eyes as the remainder of the coffee
started going down the wrong tube.
dialogues.text:
Tears came out of my eyes as the remainder of the coffee
started going down the wrong tube.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「アホかお前。仮とはいえ担任が知らない訳は
　ないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"Of course I did, silly. I'm in charge of your class after
all. Why wouldn't I know?"
dialogues.text:
"Of course I did, silly. I'm in charge of your class after
all. Why wouldn't I know?"

dialogues.jp:
お前達が付き合ってるって事もうすうす知って
たなどと、先生は澄ました顔でコーヒーを飲み
干した。
dialogues.en:
I even know that you're going out, she continued, while
calmly drinking her coffee.
dialogues.text:
I even know that you're going out, she continued, while
calmly drinking her coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「だが、いかんな」
dialogues.en: "But, that could be dangerous."
dialogues.text: "But, that could be dangerous."

dialogues.jp: ふっと真剣な表情になる暦先生。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei's face suddenly turned serious.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei's face suddenly turned serious.

dialogues.en: "...It is?"
dialogues.text: "...It is?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「少し前から気にはなっていたんだ…｛あいつ／工藤｝の身
　体はもう保たんかもしれない」
dialogues.en:
"It was less noticable earlier... but it seems her body has
just about reached it's limit."
dialogues.text:
"It was less noticable earlier... but it seems her body has
just about reached it's limit."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「付属時代からの疲労が限界近くまで溜まって
　いるんだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"The tiredness and fatigue she accumulated in the middle
grades is coming to the forefront now."
dialogues.text:
"The tiredness and fatigue she accumulated in the middle
grades is coming to the forefront now."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「もっともデリケートな成長期にああした無理
　を続けさせていたら、将来女性としての機能
　に支障をきたしてしまうかもしれん」
dialogues.en:
"If she continues straining herself during such a delicate
period in a girl's life, her body may not grow properly."
dialogues.text:
"If she continues straining herself during such a delicate
period in a girl's life, her body may not grow properly."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そんな……じゃあ叶は……」
dialogues.en: "No way... then Kanae will..."
dialogues.text: "No way... then Kanae will..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「男としての生活には、ピリオドを打たざるを
　得んな」
dialogues.en: "There's no such thing as a period in a guy's life."
dialogues.text: "There's no such thing as a period in a guy's life."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「でも、どうなるんです！？　本当のことがバ
　レたら、あいつはこの学園には居られなくなっ
　てしまうんでしょう！！」
dialogues.en:
"But what can I do!? If her secret is revealed, she won't be
able to study here any more!!"
dialogues.text:
"But what can I do!? If her secret is revealed, she won't be
able to study here any more!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は我を忘れて声をあげた。
dialogues.en: Forgetting where I was, I shouted in the heat of the moment.
dialogues.text: Forgetting where I was, I shouted in the heat of the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、声が大きい」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, you're too loud."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, you're too loud."

dialogues.jp: 眉をひそめ、指を唇にあてる。
dialogues.en: She put a finger to her lips.
dialogues.text: She put a finger to her lips.

dialogues.jp: 「あっ……すみません」
dialogues.en: "Ah... sorry."
dialogues.text: "Ah... sorry."

dialogues.jp:
「……もし……そうなったとしても、転校先の
　学園でも同じように無理しなきゃならないん
　じゃ………」
dialogues.en:
"... If... that happens, then after she transfers to another
school, she'd go through the same thing again..."
dialogues.text:
"... If... that happens, then after she transfers to another
school, she'd go through the same thing again..."

dialogues.jp:
「だいたい女の子に男の姿で暮らせなんて、も
　ともと無茶がありすぎるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"The overlying problem seems to be that it's just
unreasonable for a girl like her to try and live like a
guy."
dialogues.text:
"The overlying problem seems to be that it's just
unreasonable for a girl like her to try and live like a
guy."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「私に抗議されても困る」
dialogues.en: "I wish I could do something as well."
dialogues.text: "I wish I could do something as well."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま……ひとつだけ手段が無い訳ではないが。
　問題はお前の覚悟のほどだな」
dialogues.en:
"Well... there may be one solution. But you'd have to be
prepared for it."
dialogues.text:
"Well... there may be one solution. But you'd have to be
prepared for it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことですか？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「……工藤と直接話すがいい。あとはお前ら二
　人のことだ」
dialogues.en:
"...You should talk directly to Kudou about that. The rest
lies on the two of you."
dialogues.text:
"...You should talk directly to Kudou about that. The rest
lies on the two of you."

dialogues.jp: それは、どこか決断を促すような言葉だった。
dialogues.en: In her own way, she was urging us on.
dialogues.text: In her own way, she was urging us on.

dialogues.jp: ◆限界◆
dialogues.en: ◆Limit◆
dialogues.text: ◆Limit◆

dialogues.jp:
体育の授業の後、無理が祟ったのか叶はつい
に倒れてしまった。
dialogues.en: After gym class, Kanae had overworked herself and collapsed.
dialogues.text: After gym class, Kanae had overworked herself and collapsed.

dialogues.jp:
俺達の事を見抜いていた暦先生は、俺を呼び
止め、「叶の体はもう限界に近づいている」と
言うのだった。
dialogues.en:
Seeing through our facade, Koyomi-sensei called me to talk
to her, and told me that "Kudou's body is reaching it's
limit".
dialogues.text:
Seeing through our facade, Koyomi-sensei called me to talk
to her, and told me that "Kudou's body is reaching it's
limit".

dialogues.jp:
そして、「ただ、ひとつだけ手段がある。それ
にはお前の覚悟が必要だ」とも……。
dialogues.en:
And "there may be one solution. But you'd have to be
prepared for it."
dialogues.text:
And "there may be one solution. But you'd have to be
prepared for it."

dialogues.jp:
その言葉は、どこか決断を促すように響きだっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Those words of deciveness and urgentness echoed through my
ears.
dialogues.text:
Those words of deciveness and urgentness echoed through my
ears.
